item.title: Muscatine County Fair fundraiser to be held Saturday
item.description: Hunter 01/16/26 The Muscatine County Fair is holding their annual Blue Ribbon Fundraiser Saturday night. It will be the first event at the new Kent Center Event Space. Tickets are $30 apiece, or $350 for a table.
